title: Follie
extract:
Release Date: March 25th, 2026
Visualize the cosmic canvas of existence in pitch-black viscosity. Paint opaque silhouettes from peculiar vignettes, depicted by the Shadowgrapher, Follie, with every brushstroke and blob. Ooze and daub the foolhardy in bloody inkblots, baffled by the buffoons dangled below bulbous balloons. Portray a lighthearted parody of reality, shaded in sombre melancholy, to inspire a tinge of madness through a viscid flood of effervescent sludge. Follie emerged from her illustrious painting in Update 42.0 (2026-03-25): The Shadowgrapher.
 Follie is an inkblots and painter-themed Warframe with a sad clown aesthetic. Her Passive has her abilities splash ink onto enemies, causing them to be  Slowed as well as create Health Orbs and Energy Orbs when slain.  Forced Perspective repositions Follie with an inkblot pool while also becoming Invulnerable and cleanses Status Effects.  Shadowgraph picturizes a variety of tools and equipment, often including mission-exclusive items.  Self Portrait creates an inky clone of herself, granting Damage Reduction.  Plein Air attaches enemies to balloons, causing them to harmlessly float upward while stripping their Armor and Shields, and popping the balloon drops them to the ground to inflict deadly fall damage.

Acquisition
Follie's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Rotation A of Follie's Hunt on Vesper Relay, Venus. Access requires completion of Chains of Harrow.
Alternatively they can be purchased from Aspirant Zorba in any relay in exchange for  Atramentum, awarded from Follie's Hunt. Each component blueprint requires 400  and the main blueprint requires 1200 , totaling 2400  Atramentum for the whole set.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Crafting

Lore

As more  Atramentum is gathered in Follie's Hunt, Zorba gains a greater understanding of the sacred script of Hexis, allowing him to read the letters left to him by his disappeared mentor. There are five letters, requiring 1,200  Atramentum in total to be gathered. Progress towards each letter is shown after a successful mission.

First Letter
Requires 50  Atramentum.

I can read the first letter now! 
It's really short. Here goes. 'Work hard. 
Study... far? No. Study long. Good Zorba. 

Happy Kozai.'

Second Letter
Requires 150  Atramentum.

Letter number two. 'Zorba. Kozai has work to do. 
Teach... I don't know this word. Teach... blobby thing? 
...truth. Learn truth too. Much change.

Big surprise.' Ah... okay?

Third Letter
Requires 300  Atramentum.

Third letter. 'Follie is not evil.
Follie is... a teller of truths. I taught her Hexis stories.
You are learning and she is learning.
She makes my stories into... pictures.

You must make her ink into words.'

Fourth Letter
Requires 600  Atramentum.

'I have learned something of Follie's own truth.
She was not always as you see her now.
Once she was a painter of hidden truths, bringing secrets to light for healing's sake.
But other sought to... um... crooked line... warp?

Twist? Pervert her gifts. She was put into service to cruel masters.'

Final Letter
Requires 1200  Atramentum.'The Fomorians will be here soon. 
I will give these letters to our Preceptory Cephalon.
We shall not meet again, my student, my friend. 
I must keep Follie safe. If you are reading this, you will understand why, and with what reason we should revere Follie as a Holy Fool, one of the Saints of Truth. 

I am confident you will be a just and wise Arbiter of Hexis. '

Notes
When Follie wields her Signature  Enkaus, its Alternate Fire applies Inkblot.

Trivia
Follie's name means "madness" in French.
When taken in combination with her visual design of a Rorschach or Inkblot test, her name could be a reference to "Folie à deux," a rare psychiatric condition in which symptoms of a delusional belief are "transmitted" from one individual to another.
Follie is the 64th unique Warframe to be released.
Follie's painting at the Vesper Relay can be entered, which is a reference to Super Mario 64. Coincidentally or intentionally, Follie is the 64th standalone Warframe introduced to the game.
When her animations were originally shown during Devstream 192, Follie was represented as an untextured  Hildryn with  Gauss Prime's helmet and black orbs on her hips, shoulders and head.
Follie is the first Warframe whose color scheme is entirely achromatic by default, including her energy.
Despite this, she is strongly associated with the color purple in official art and in the level design of Follie's Hunt. Her ink also has iridescent purple hues which cannot be changed by altering her energy colour.
Follie's visual design appears to take influences from a variety of sources including Pierrot clown costumes, Rorschach/inkblot tests, and other pop culture clowns such as Pennywise from Stephen King's "It".
Her default helmet is vaguely shaped like a Lepidoptera head.
The ink on Follie's body and helmet appears to constantly flow and is tinted by her energy colour.
Shadowgraphy, also known as ombromanie, involves casting hand shadows on a surface to create animated animal or object shapes for storytelling.
Shadowgraph is an optical method to reveal non-uniformities in transparent media (such as air, water, or glass) to reveal temperature, gases, or shockwaves otherwise invisible to the human eye, yet still casts shadows by refracting light rays.
 Plein Air is derived from En plein air, the practice of painting outdoors.
The designer of Follie, [DE]Skyers, also designed  Jade and  Khora. Follie was a two year project that began as an ink clown with balloons during concept art, then [DE]Pablo developed more painter-esque abilities such as  Shadowgraph and its Brush Strokes system.
Follie is the first Warframe that can summon actual tileset objects where other Warframes can use the object models. She is also the first to be able to summon an enemy, via Lohk Surge.
